text:
Ravi: Heads-up from SI delivery call
Weird failure: partner images failing verification in staging after cert rotation. Need immediate arch triage.

Sofia: What error? Can you paste the pull log?

Ravi: `docker pull registry.partner.local/catalyst:staging` -> `denied: signature verification failed: certificate unknown`

Kim: Sounds like the new marketplace CA wasn't added to our image verifier truststore. Which tenant?

Ravi: tenant: catalyst-int. Rotation happened last night per partner note.

Andre: CI shows auto-rotation job applied a new cert but the helm chart still references old `trusted-ca-secret:v1`. Quick check: `kubectl get secret trusted-ca -n catalyst-staging -o yaml` shows `annotations: rotated: "true"` but value looks unchanged.

ci-bot: build/verify-image-signatures failed for staging (job 4821) 1:22 UTC 
https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4821

Sofia: @security-bot can you confirm if the marketplace CA bundle update propagated to our verifier service?

security-bot: CA bundle push for tenant catalyst-int completed at 21:35 UTC. 3 endpoints reported success, 1 reported mismatch (verifier-02).

Kim: verifier-02 is on the old AMI and hasn't picked up the edge-config reload. I'll trigger a rolling restart for the verifier deployment.

Andre: Rolling restart started: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/verifier -n infra`

Ravi: Partner is online waiting for the deploy window. Can we get pods back in <10m?

ci-bot: verifier pods are restarting (verifier-01, verifier-02, verifier-03)

Sofia: While restarting, let's prepare a quick fallback: allow images to be pulled from our cache registry `redwood-cache.partner/catalyst` until verification is green. That needs a temporary egress rule to 10.8.9.5:5000. Security, can you approve tempo rule?

security-bot: Emergency egress rule approved for 30 minutes to 10.8.9.5:5000 from namespace catalyst-staging. Audit ticket SEC-772 created.

Kim: verifier-02 is back, healthcheck passed. Re-running image pull verification.

ci-bot: verify-image-signatures job retriggered 
job/4821-retry -> success

Ravi: Pull now succeeds, staging pods progressing to Running.

Andre: Root cause: AMI bake missed the new config that triggers dynamic cert reload on startup. Follow-ups: 1) Add verifier config check to SI preflight, 2) Add canary to AMI rollouts for infra critical path, 3) Document cache-registry fallback in partner runbook. I'll file infra task INF-909.

Sofia: I'll message partner that the window is back on and note the workaround taken.

Ravi: Thanks team. Capturing items in INF-909 and SEC-772. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
